in_arabic.name: دلشاد
in_arabic.long_meaning: دلشاد هو اسم عربي مشتق من الجذور الفارسية والتركية، يجمع بين معاني الفرح والسرور والغبطة، ويتوافق مع الروح الإسلامية التي تُشجع على البشاشة والتفاؤل، ويُستخدم تاريخياً في الثقافات الإسلامية لتعزيز الروح الإيجابية

in_urdu.name: دلشاد
in_urdu.long_meaning: دلشاد ایک نام ہے جو فارسی اور ترکی الجڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی خوشی اور خوشحالی کے ہیں، اور یہ اسلامی روایات کے ساتھ مطابقت رکھتا ہے جو مسکراہٹ اور امید پر زور دیتی ہیں، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم ثقافت میں خوشی کے پیغام کو فروغ دینے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: दिलशाद
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिलशाद एक नाम है जो फारसी और तुर्की मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ खुशी और आनंद है, और यह इस्लामी परंपराओं के साथ संगत है जो मुस्कराहट और आशा पर जोर देती हैं, और यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में खुशी के संदेश को बढ़ावा देने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: دلشاد

data.cultural_impact: The name Dilshaad is of Persian origin, derived from the words 'dil' meaning heart and 'shaad' meaning joy. The name Dilshaad is a beautiful and joyful sounding name that resonates with the Islamic culture which places a great emphasis on inner happiness and joy. It is a name that is often given to children as a wish for their happiness and joy in life. The name is also a reminder of the significance of spreading joy and happiness to others, reflecting the Islamic values of kindness, compassion, and generosity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dilshaad has a deep spiritual significance in Islam. It is a reminder of the importance of experiencing joy and happiness in the heart, rather than seeking it from external sources. The name encourages us to find joy and contentment within ourselves, through our connection to Allah and our adherence to His commands. It also serves as a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) saying, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charitable deeds." thereby encouraging us to bring joy and happiness to others through acts of kindness and generosity. Ultimately, the name Dilshaad encourages us to strive for an inner joy and happiness that comes from a deep connection to Allah, and to spread joy and happiness to others as a manifestation of our faith and commitment to Him.
